source.upstream_origin: historical Cars.com listing extraction performed by the dataset author

permission_evidence.kind: project-owner attestation of direct source contact
permission_evidence.summary: The project owner reports being in contact with the relevant source and confirms that the historical acquisition and this noncommercial portfolio ML use were authorized and performed legally.

retrieval.required_method: official KaggleHub v1.0.2 download of version 2

market_scope.raw_scope: United States according to the Kaggle description and upstream repository
market_scope.observation_period: 2023 source snapshots; no row-level observation timestamp

target.approved_claim: historical U.S. advertised asking-price estimate for New, Used, and Certified listings represented by the 2023 source snapshots

notes: New, Used, and Certified are retained as explicit vehicle_status categories so the expanded model can learn their different price regimes.
Every target-valid New row and two target-valid Used rows have missing Mileage; later pipelines must learn missing-value handling inside training folds and report metrics by status.
Dealer is provenance-only source content and must not enter normalized artifacts or model features.
Extreme prices require training-fold-only outlier analysis; the acquisition adapter must not silently winsorize targets.

required_processing_gates: Verify the exact CSV byte size and SHA-256 before and after streaming parse.
Require the exact seven-column schema and UTF-16 BOM encoding.
Retain New, Used, and Certified as explicit vehicle_status categories; quarantine unknown status values.
Require non-empty brand and model, a valid vehicle year, optional nonnegative integral mileage, and a positive finite Price.
Remove Dealer from every normalized record, feature table, rejection message, identifier, and published artifact.
Deduplicate exact source rows without exposing source values in identifiers.
Represent Price as USD asking-price cents and label every result as a historical U.S. advertised asking-price estimate.
Keep this asking-price target separate from the completed wholesale-auction target unless an explicitly designed domain feature or multi-task experiment is reviewed.
Do not scrape Cars.com from AutoValue AI; this approval covers only the already-created, version-pinned Kaggle artifact.
Fit imputers, encoders, category grouping, outlier rules, and all learned transforms on training folds only.
Do not commit or redistribute raw rows, processed rows, or a downloadable model without a new permission decision.

allowed: aggregate charts that do not expose source rows
hosted predictions from an approved deployment
blocked_pending_review: row-level examples copied from the dataset

notes: Kaggle displays an Apache 2.0 license label and identifies the upstream repository; this project separately records the project owner's authorization attestation.
The authorization attestation is the basis for scoped use in this noncommercial portfolio and is not a general sublicense or legal conclusion.
The two Kaggle datasets describe different targets and will be evaluated as separate modeling tracks rather than concatenated as if their labels were equivalent.
